narrative.overview:
Mars Bank plots frontier finance as survey work, not as a conservative card stack and not as a space-game HUD. Public pages sit on graphite like a coordinate sheet: Macquarie-like information architecture, film-balanced hero, orbital-arc lockup. Authenticated pages invert the ground to survey mint paper and keep graphite as retained left navigation and ink. Both surfaces share one palette, one condensed display face, and one-pixel rules.

The memorable banking moment is a single plotted register. The available total, every account column, and the movement rail use the same numeral language, so the customer reads the whole bank as one exact coordinate instead of a pile of product cards.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite public ground; mint authenticated paper; oxide for action; signal for coordinates, totals, and focus
One-pixel survey rules instead of nested cards and soft elevation
Saira Extra Condensed for lockup, headings, and money; Saira for body and metadata
Orbital-arc ellipse lockup with an oxide node and signal ticks
Sharp corners on register surfaces; the only circles are the mark and small avatars

rules.name: The Signal Coordinate Rule
rules.body: Signal is for plotted values and focus. Oxide is for doing. Mint and graphite are for ground. Do not reintroduce Macquarie blue fills.

rules.name: The Survey Ink Rule
rules.body: Structure the register with 1px graphite (or line) rules. Do not nest white cards, drop shadows, or 8–10px content radii on authenticated ledgers.

rules.name: The Condensed Money Rule
rules.body: Money, page titles, and column headers use Extra Condensed. Do not set balances in italic serif or in regular Saira at display size.

rules.name: The Shared Column Rule
rules.body: Every visible account on a register view shares one column set. Do not give each product its own card layout.

rules.name: The Flat Register Rule
rules.body: Ledger surfaces do not lift. If a control needs emphasis, change fill (oxide) or ink (signal), not shadow.

rules.name: The One Circle Rule
rules.body: Circles belong to the lockup and avatars. Do not round the register, the position band, or form controls.

dos: Do keep public IA Macquarie-like and swap identity to Mars Bank + orbital lockup.
Do put authenticated work on mint paper with a graphite rail and 1px survey rules.
Do plot totals and available money in signal Extra Condensed.
Do use oxide for the only primary action on a view (login, transfer, freeze secondary stays outline).
Do label synthetic balances as model tokens.
Do stack the account register above the movement rail below 1180px; keep the mobile tab bar.
donts: Don't use sci-fi HUD glow, planet globes, or game chrome.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow above a headline.
Don't rebuild the overview as a stack of conservative bank-product cards.
Don't fill public or register fields with Macquarie-like blue blocks.
Don't round register containers or rely on card shadows for hierarchy.
Don't set display type in italic serif.
